'''Kids Station''' (Japanese: '''キッズステーション''' ''Kids Station'') is a television cable channel showing animation and other cartoon material.

==Information==
Kids Station reruns the [[original series]], ''[[Pokémon the Series: Ruby and Sapphire]]'', ''[[Pokémon the Series: Black & White]]'' and ''[[Pokémon the Series: XY]]'' episodes and movies.
